verdict.rationale: Postmark provides a documented test mode via the POSTMARK_API_TEST token that processes requests without actually sending emails, plus a separate 'Server sandbox mode' and fake bounce generation for testing bounce handling — all without touching production data or real inboxes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox behavior, and clarity on how sandbox mode isolates test data (e.g., separate activity logs/stats) from production.
